info.title: UAIX Browser p2pRuntime Seed Host Tool
info.description: Installable .NET tool and self-contained command application for user-run MiniModel .slm P2P seed fleets. It uses the UAIX Browser SeedHost library and reviewed Rust MiniModel binaries; it does not proxy model bytes through project infrastructure.
